mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,paper_no,blueprint_id,blueprint_version_snapshot,fixed_paper_id,fixed_paper_code,fixed_paper_version,status,started_at,due_at, submitted_at,objective_score,translation_self_score,writing_self_score,self_score_total, version,created_at,updated_at FROM exam_paper WHERE id=#{paperId} AND user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,paper_id,paper_group_snapshot_id,original_question_id,section_order,item_order, question_type,stem,options,correct_answer,explanation,reference_answer,sample_answer, scoring_rubric,knowledge_points,score,created_at FROM exam_paper_item_snapshot WHERE id=#{paperItemId} AND paper_id=#{paperId}
SELECT id,paper_id,paper_item_id,answer_content,answer_version,saved_at,objectively_correct,earned_score FROM exam_answer WHERE paper_id=#{paperId} AND paper_item_id=#{paperItemId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,paper_id,paper_item_id,answer_content,answer_version,saved_at,objectively_correct,earned_score FROM exam_answer WHERE paper_id=#{paperId} ORDER BY paper_item_id
SELECT id,user_id,paper_id,paper_item_id,original_question_id,wrong_answer,knowledge_points,created_at FROM exam_wrong_record WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND paper_id=#{paperId} ORDER BY paper_item_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_paper WHERE user_id=#{userId}

SELECT i.question_type,w.knowledge_points,COUNT(*) AS wrong_count FROM exam_wrong_record w JOIN exam_paper p ON p.id=w.paper_id AND p.user_id=w.user_id JOIN exam_paper_item_snapshot i ON i.id=w.paper_item_id AND i.paper_id=w.paper_id WHERE w.user_id=#{userId} AND p.status IN ('SUBMITTED','AUTO_SUBMITTED') AND i.question_type IN ('DIALOGUE_BLANK','READING','VOCABULARY','GRAMMAR') GROUP BY i.question_type,w.knowledge_points
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_answer SET objectively_correct=#{objectivelyCorrect},earned_score=#{earnedScore} WHERE paper_id=#{paperId} AND paper_item_id=#{paperItemId}
